act: Indian regulatory corpus (5,082 supplied PDFs): second held-out set
reviewNote: Second held-out set, drafted by an AI coding assistant on 2026-09-29 after the verifier tuning on the dev and test splits of full-corpus.eval.json and frozen before any run. Every expected fact is a verbatim substring of every listed acceptable document in the local full-corpus SQLite index; acceptable documents were computed mechanically. No family overlaps the first set. No case is lawyer-reviewed; expected facts describe the indexed text, not verified current law.
